1. (Currently amended) A tool comprising a lamination of at least two layers and an adhesive layer, the tool comprising first and second layers and __a first adhesive layer and a second adhesive layer__, the tool having a circular shape and including a plurality of arc-shaped cutting segments having an inner arc shape and an outer arc shape, wherein the inner arc shape of each of the arc-shaped cutting segments is directly affixed to an outer perimeter of the first and second layers, __a medial section positioned between the first and second layers, wherein the first adhesive layer is positioned on one side of the medial section and the second adhesive layer is positioned on an opposite side of the medial section, and wherein the first layer and the second layer are aligned with the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer respectively__.

2. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 281 wherein the medial section comprises a metal.

3. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 282 wherein the metal is a honeycomb structure.

4. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 282 wherein the medial section is a composite material.

5. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 281 further including a weld ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers and the plurality of arc-shaped cutting segments.

6. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 285 wherein the weld ring is bonded to the medial section.

7. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 285 wherein the plurality of arc-shaped cutting segments are welded to an outer perimeter of the weld ring.

8. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 285 wherein the weld ring is continuous.

9. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 285 further including an inner ring, wherein the medial section is coupled on an inner perimeter to the inner ring.

10. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 290 wherein __the inner ring includes a central opening__ for accommodating a drive shaft.

11. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 281 further including a weld ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers and the plurality of arc-shaped cutting segments, such that the plurality of arc-shaped cutting segments are located on an outer periphery of the weld ring.

12. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 293 wherein the weld ring is continuous.

13. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 285 wherein the weld ring is segmented.

14. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 293 wherein the weld ring is segmented.
